name: Kit-owned folders inside a project directory are refused when they are links
summary: A kit-owned folder beside a project (.read-cache, .assignee-followons, .task-files and the folders inside it) is checked with lstat and refused when it is a symlink or not a directory, so nothing is written or served through a planted link: read_cache._cache_directory, followon._journal_directory / open_journal, task_files._directory. The project directory itself is refused as a symlink by admin.project_dir.
